rows.note: Lith A5 or Lith K11 or Lith M8 or Lith T11 or Neo D1 or Neo N2 or Axi A5 or Axi M4 or Axi P5 or Axi S7 or Axi V3, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Vasto Prime Receiver
rows.note: Lith A1 or Lith G11 or Lith V9 or Meso N16 or Meso V2 or Neo B8 or Neo N12 or Neo R5 or Neo T8 or Axi A5, Common: 25.33% Intact

conditions: Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Common-part relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
